```yaml
name: End-to-End Tests

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main, master, develop ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main, master, develop ]

jobs:
  e2e-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    
    strategy:
      matrix:
        python-version: ['3.11', '3.12', '3.13']
    
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4
    
    - name: Set up Python ${{ matrix.python-version }}
      uses: actions/setup-python@v5
      with:
        python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}
    
    - name: Set up uv package manager
      uses: pytorch/test-infra/.github/actions/setup-uv@main
      with:
        python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}
    
    - name: Install Python dependencies
      run: |
        uv pip install --system -e .
        uv pip install --system pytest pytest-html selenium
    
    - name: Install Chrome and ChromeDriver
      run: |
        sudo apt-get update
        sudo apt-get install -y wget unzip
        wget -q -O /tmp/chromedriver.zip http://chromedriver.storage.googleapis.com/`curl -sS chromedriver.storage.googleapis.com/LATEST_RELEASE`/chromedriver_linux64.zip
        sudo unzip /tmp/chromedriver.zip chromedriver -d /usr/local/bin/
        sudo chmod +x /usr/local/bin/chromedriver
        google-chrome --version
    
    - name: Install tttool
      run: |
        mkdir -p ~/.local/bin
        wget -q https://github.com/tobiaslounsbury/tttool/releases/download/v1.8.1/tttool-linux-x64.tar.gz
        tar -xzf tttool-linux-x64.tar.gz
        mv tttool ~/.local/bin/
        chmod +x ~/.local/bin/tttool
    
    - name: Install ffmpeg
      run: |
        sudo apt-get install -y ffmpeg
    
    - name: Start ttmp32gme server
      run: |
        cd src
        python -m ttmp32gme.ttmp32gme &
        echo $! > /tmp/ttmp32gme.pid
        sleep 5
      env:
        TTMP32GME_PORT: 10020
        TTMP32GME_DB_PATH: /tmp/test.db
    
    - name: Run end-to-end tests
      run: |
        pytest tests/ -v --tb=short --html=report.html --self-contained-html -k "not test_web_frontend"
      env:
        TTMP32GME_URL: http://localhost:10020
        TTMP32GME_TEST_MODE: true
    
    - name: Stop ttmp32gme server
      run: |
        if [ -f /tmp/ttmp32gme.pid ]; then
          kill $(cat /tmp/ttmp32gme.pid) || true
        fi
      if: always()
    
    - name: Upload test report
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: e2e-test-report-${{ matrix.python-version }}
        path: report.html
      if: always()
    
    - name: Upload test artifacts
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: test-artifacts-${{ matrix.python-version }}
        path: |
          src/config.sqlite
          /tmp/test.db
      if: always()

  copilot-setup:
    needs: e2e-test
    if: always()
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
    - name: Verify Copilot setup
      run: |
        echo "Copilot environment verification complete"
        echo "Python version: $(python --version)"
        echo "tttool version: $(tttool --version 2>/dev/null || echo 'Not installed')"
        echo "ffmpeg version: $(ffmpeg -version 2>&1 | head -n 1)"
        echo "Chrome version: $(google-chrome --version 2>/dev/null || echo 'Not installed')"
```
